name: Wan-kuri
source:
While at a dump, you pick up a thrown away dog-human creature called "Mikku". 

Your warm and delightfully naughty cohabitation with your new pet is about to begin!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE041753.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在垃圾场时，你捡起了一只被丢弃的狗人生物，名为“Mikku”。

你和你的新宠物的温馨又调皮的同居即将开始！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE041753.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
